label: Tenancy: a tenant challenging a rent increase, including nullity for defect of form

contract.scope:
TENANCY (Switzerland, federal law): a residential or commercial tenant challenging a rent increase — or another unilateral change of the lease to the tenant's detriment — notified by the landlord under OR 269d, INCLUDING the branch in which the increase is null for defect of form (OR 269d Abs. 2 read with VMWG Art. 19/19a and the cantonally approved form). Runs from the applicability gate (OR 253a/253b) through characterisation of the communication and of the rent regime (ordinary / index-linked OR 269b / staggered OR 269c), the formal validity and content of the notification, the nullity determination, the timing rules (OR 269d Abs. 1; VMWG 17 Abs. 3, 19 Abs. 2, 19a), the 30-day challenge to the conciliation authority (OR 270b Abs. 1), the conciliation procedure (ZPO 197-213), the ROLE-REVERSED allocation of the Klagebewilligung (ZPO 209 Abs. 1 lit. a), the 30-day Klagefrist (ZPO 209 Abs. 4) and the court stage in the simplified procedure (ZPO 243 Abs. 2 lit. c, 244, 247 Abs. 2), plus the rent owed pendente lite (OR 270e), the cost regime (ZPO 113, 207) and the separately-clocked contestability of a termination coupled to the increase (OR 271a Abs. 1 lit. b/d, 273 Abs. 1).

EXCLUDED: the challenge of the INITIAL rent (OR 270, VMWG 19 Abs. 3) and the termination/extension procedure itself (OR 271 ff., 272 ff.) beyond the single determination D25.

STATUTORY SNAPSHOTS: OR (SR 220) consolidated 01.01.2026; ZPO (SR 272) consolidated 01.01.2025; VMWG (SR 221.213.11) consolidated 01.10.2025.

AUTHORITY-ID CONVENTION. Ids of the form <act>-art-<n>-para<n>-<consolidation>-de are taken verbatim from swiss-authority-bundle-v1.json where that bundle contains the passage (OR 269a, 269d Abs. 1-2, 270b Abs. 1, 271 Abs. 1-2, 273 Abs. 1; VMWG 11 Abs. 1, 19 Abs. 1-2, 20, 21, 22; ZPO 197, 198, 200, 201, 202 Abs. 1, 203 Abs. 1, 205 Abs. 1, 206 Abs. 1, 208 Abs. 1, 209 Abs. 1/3/4, 243 Abs. 2, 244 Abs. 3, 247 Abs. 2). Passages NOT in the bundle carry the same id shape with the consolidation date of the Fedlex snapshot independently fetched and string-matched for this contract. Operational sources carry ids <canton>-<artefact>-<date>.

QUOTE NORMALISATION (declared so every quote is mechanically checkable). All quotes were string-matched after collapsing runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces. Two rendering differences are absorbed by that normalisation and by nothing else: (a) Fedlex's HTML renders an article suffix letter with an intervening space ("Artikel 269 a", "Art. 19 a", "1 bis") where the XML and the bundle have none ("Artikel 269a", "Art. 19a", "1bis") — quotes are given in the XML/bundle form; (b) the cantonal PDFs break words across lines with a soft hyphen — quotes were chosen to avoid hyphenated spans wherever possible, and where a span could not be avoided the hyphen-plus-linebreak is normalised to a plain hyphen. Every quote below was re-verified by this adjudication, not taken on either annotator's word.

ADJUDICATION RECORD — what was verified, merged, corrected and dropped.

VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY: the three Fedlex consolidated texts were re-fetched (OR 2 660 898 bytes, ZPO 508 829, VMWG 45 554, all HTTP 200, sizes matching both annotators' reports); the Aargau Schlichtungsgesuch re-hashes to 588ae9817d29420c10f1145c7607ff2867fbcb5ebd8403a7136e8f71242735aa, the Zurich Formular-Mietzinserhoehung to 4c02dfcb92d096e435b9a4935bc20be4284b5f73df7dacef52ae837b37e27ccf, the Geneva Requete-contestation-hausse to d9572223ebb9527283438fe59216b96bc80acbd4fdfb0519b1b5451d06fcd48a, the Zurich Merkblatt to 3254a78daddf68b07b7f188743302385f3b8fc7ab65109bb62f9c0bc306c6037 and the Zurich Mietzinsanfechtung form to 2a4359be32824ed66fb7d0b8b7eb6a7340c4ee2a55a2ea622e62e7e8b910994d — all matching what the annotators recorded. 130 distinct quoted spans were batch-matched against those sources; 0 failed.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the abusive-rent protection of OR 269 ff. reaches this object and this lease at all: that the let object is Wohn- oder Geschaeftsraeume (or a thing let together with such rooms), that it is not a luxury dwelling or a single-family house with six or more habitable rooms excluding the kitchen, and that it is not publicly promoted housing whose rent is controlled by an authority. A negative answer ends the scope before any question of form, timing or substance arises.
quotes: Die Bestimmungen über die Miete von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen gelten auch für Sachen, die der Vermieter zusammen mit diesen Räumen dem Mieter zum Gebrauch überlässt.
Sie gelten nicht für die Miete von luxuriösen Wohnungen und Einfamilienhäusern mit sechs oder mehr Wohnräumen (ohne Anrechnung der Küche).

Die Bestimmungen über die Anfechtung missbräuchlicher Mietzinse gelten nicht für Wohnräume, deren Bereitstellung von der öffentlichen Hand gefördert wurde und deren Mietzinse durch eine Behörde kontrolliert werden.
Bei Streitigkeiten aus Miete und Pacht von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen besteht die Schlichtungsbehörde aus einer vorsitzenden Person und einer paritätischen Vertretung.

decisions.must_determine: How the landlord's communication is characterised, and under which rent regime the lease stands. Two things must come out: (a) that the communication is a rent increase or another unilateral change of the lease to the tenant's detriment within OR 269d — as opposed to an initial-rent fixing or a mere ancillary-cost statement; and (b) whether the rent is ordinary, index-linked under OR 269b, or staggered under OR 269c. This classification selects which of D9, D10, D12 and D13 is live and which formal regime applies. A reconstruction may split it into 'is it an increase' and 'which regime' and still satisfy the requirement.
quotes: Der Vermieter kann den Mietzins jederzeit auf den nächstmöglichen Kündigungstermin erhöhen.

Die Absätze 1 und 2 gelten auch, wenn der Vermieter beabsichtigt, sonstwie den Mietvertrag einseitig zu Lasten des Mieters zu ändern, namentlich seine bisherigen Leistungen zu vermindern oder neue Nebenkosten einzuführen.
Absatz 1 gilt auch, wenn der Vermieter sonstwie den Mietvertrag einseitig zu Lasten des Mieters ändert, namentlich seine bisherigen Leistungen vermindert oder neue Nebenkosten einführt.

Die Vereinbarung, dass der Mietzins einem Index folgt, ist nur gültig, wenn der Mietvertrag für mindestens fünf Jahre abgeschlossen und als Index der Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise vorgesehen wird.

Die Vereinbarung, dass sich der Mietzins periodisch um einen bestimmten Betrag erhöht, ist nur gültig, wenn: a. der Mietvertrag für mindestens drei Jahre abgeschlossen wird; b. der Mietzins höchstens einmal jährlich erhöht wird; und c. der Betrag der Erhöhung in Franken festgelegt wird.
Anfechtung einer Mietzinserhöhung (Art. 270b Abs. 1/Art. 269 ff. OR).

decisions.must_determine: The date on which the notification reached the tenant. This single determination anchors two clocks that run in opposite directions: forward, the 30-day challenge period, which begins on the day AFTER the communication; and backward, the ten-day minimum lead before the start of the notice period. Any reconstruction that fixes a receipt date satisfies this, however it names the node; a reconstruction that fixes only the date of dispatch does not.
quotes: Der Mieter kann eine Mietzinserhöhung innert 30 Tagen, nachdem sie ihm mitgeteilt worden ist, bei der Schlichtungsbehörde als missbräuchlich im Sinne der Artikel 269 und 269a anfechten.
Fristen, die durch eine Mitteilung oder den Eintritt eines Ereignisses ausgelöst werden, beginnen am folgenden Tag zu laufen.
Mitteilung erhalten am
innert 30 Tagen nach Empfang der Mitteilung
dans les 30 jours dès la réception de l’avis de hausse de loyer ou d’autres modifications du bail

decisions.must_determine: Whether the increase was notified on the PRESCRIBED form, i.e. on a form approved by the canton in which the premises lie — either the form the canton itself issues, or the landlord's own form carrying that canton's approval endorsement with its date. A mechanically reproduced signature on the prescribed form suffices and does not defeat the requirement.
quotes: Er muss dem Mieter die Mietzinserhöhung mindestens zehn Tage vor Beginn der Kündigungsfrist auf einem vom Kanton genehmigten Formular mitteilen und begründen.
Die Mietzinserhöhung ist nichtig, wenn der Vermieter: a. sie nicht mit dem vorgeschriebenen Formular mitteilt; b. sie nicht begründet; c. mit der Mitteilung die Kündigung androht oder ausspricht.
Für die Mitteilung einer Mietzinserhöhung und anderer einseitiger Vertragsänderungen genügt eine auf mechanischem Weg nachgebildete Unterschrift auf dem vorgeschriebenen Formular.
Die Kantone sorgen dafür, dass in den Gemeinden Formulare in genügender Zahl zur Verfügung stehen.

Vermieterinnen und Vermieter, welche nicht die amtlichen Formulare gebrauchen möchten, können eigene Formulare verwenden. Ein solches Formular muss aber vor seiner Verwendung von der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern genehmigt werden.
Auf dem Formular muss folgender Genehmigungsvermerk angebracht werden:
occorre far capo obbligatoriamente ai moduli allestiti dal Dipartimento delle istituzioni, pena la nullità delle relative notifiche.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the form as served carries every mandatory item of VMWG Art. 19 Abs. 1: the previous rent and previous ancillary-cost burden; the new rent and new burden; the date the increase takes effect; a clear reason with each asserted ground shown as a separate franc amount; where improvements are invoked, the statement whether the landlord receives subsidies; plus, in every case, the statutory conditions of challenge and the register of conciliation authorities with their local jurisdiction. Where the reasons are given in an accompanying letter, whether the form expressly says so. Where the landlord exercises only part of the adjustment open to him, whether the reservation is expressed in francs or as a percentage.
quotes: Das Formular für die Mitteilung von Mietzinserhöhungen und anderen einseitigen Vertragsänderungen im Sinne von Artikel 269d OR muss enthalten:
den bisherigen Mietzins und die bisherige Belastung des Mieters für Nebenkosten;
den neuen Mietzins und die neue Belastung des Mieters für Nebenkosten;
den Zeitpunkt, auf den die Erhöhung in Kraft tritt;
die klare Begründung der Erhöhung. Werden mehrere Erhöhungsgründe geltend gemacht, so sind diese je in Einzelbeträgen auszuweisen;
bei Mehrleistungen die Angabe, ob der Vermieter Förderbeiträge für wertvermehrende Verbesserungen erhält.
die gesetzlichen Voraussetzungen der Anfechtung; 2. das Verzeichnis der Schlichtungsbehörden und ihre örtliche Zuständigkeit.
Erfolgt die Begründung in einem Begleitschreiben, so hat der Vermieter im Formular ausdrücklich darauf hinzuweisen.
Macht der Vermieter die ihm zustehende Mietzinsanpassung nicht vollständig geltend, hat er diesen Vorbehalt in Franken oder in Prozenten des Mietzinses festzulegen.
sie nicht begründet;
Begründung gemäss separatem Begleitschreiben
Ist der Vermieter der Meinung, dass er die ihm zustehende Erhöhung nicht voll ausschöpft, so muss er in der Begründung einen bezifferten Vorbehalt anbringen

decisions.must_determine: Whether the notification, or anything served together with it, threatens or declares a termination of the lease. This is a self-standing limb of the nullity rule and is decided independently of the form's provenance and of its content.
quotes: mit der Mitteilung die Kündigung androht oder ausspricht.
Der Auszug aus den massgeblichen Bestimmungen des Obligationenrechts auf Seite 3 ist Bestandteil dieses amtlichen Formulars.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the increase is NULL under OR 269d Abs. 2 — whether any one of the three independent limbs (not notified on the prescribed form; not reasoned; termination threatened or declared with it) is made out — and, if so, that the increase produces no effect at all and requires no challenge by the tenant. A reconstruction that folds the three limbs into one nullity node, or splits nullity into three, still satisfies this requirement provided the DISJUNCTIVE structure and the no-challenge-needed consequence both survive. This is the scope's second, independent route to a terminal outcome and it requires no substantive assessment of the rent.
quotes: Die Mietzinserhöhung ist nichtig, wenn der Vermieter: a. sie nicht mit dem vorgeschriebenen Formular mitteilt; b. sie nicht begründet; c. mit der Mitteilung die Kündigung androht oder ausspricht.
Die Mietzinserhöhung ist nichtig (ohne Anfechtung unwirksam), wenn sie ohne Formular erfolgt, nicht klar begründet wird oder wenn mit ihr eine Kündigungsdrohung einher geht

decisions.must_determine: Whether the notification observed the timing rule of OR 269d Abs. 1: the increase may bite only on the next possible termination date, and the notification must reach the tenant at least ten days before the notice period running to that date begins. Making the determination requires identifying the applicable notice period and termination dates from the lease, or in their absence from the statutory default for the type of premises. The consequence of a late but otherwise valid notification is DEFERRAL, not nullity: the increase then takes effect only at the next-but-one termination date. A reconstruction that treats a short lead as a nullity ground has failed this decision.
quotes: Der Vermieter kann den Mietzins jederzeit auf den nächstmöglichen Kündigungstermin erhöhen. Er muss dem Mieter die Mietzinserhöhung mindestens zehn Tage vor Beginn der Kündigungsfrist auf einem vom Kanton genehmigten Formular mitteilen und begründen.
Die Parteien können das unbefristete Mietverhältnis unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Fristen und Termine kündigen, sofern sie keine längere Frist oder keinen anderen Termin vereinbart haben.
Halten die Parteien die Frist oder den Termin nicht ein, so gilt die Kündigung für den nächstmöglichen Termin.
Bei der Miete von Wohnungen können die Parteien mit einer Frist von drei Monaten auf einen ortsüblichen Termin oder, wenn es keinen Ortsgebrauch gibt, auf Ende einer dreimonatigen Mietdauer kündigen.

Bei der Miete von Geschäftsräumen können die Parteien mit einer Frist von sechs Monaten auf einen ortsüblichen Termin oder, wenn es keinen Ortsgebrauch gibt, auf Ende einer dreimonatigen Mietdauer kündigen.
Sonst wirkt die Erhöhung erst auf den übernächsten Kündigungstermin

decisions.must_determine: For a staggered rent: whether the written notification of the step was given no earlier than four months before that step takes effect, and whether written form was used at all. On this branch written form SUFFICES and the cantonally approved official form is not required — which is why D4 and D5 close here.
quotes: Bei gestaffelten Mietzinsen darf die schriftliche Mitteilung frühestens vier Monate vor Eintritt jeder Mietzinserhöhung erfolgen.
Für die Mitteilung von Mietzinserhöhungen, die in einer Vereinbarung nach Artikel 269c vorgesehen sind, genügt die schriftliche Form.

Die Vereinbarung, dass sich der Mietzins periodisch um einen bestimmten Betrag erhöht, ist nur gültig, wenn: a. der Mietvertrag für mindestens drei Jahre abgeschlossen wird; b. der Mietzins höchstens einmal jährlich erhöht wird; und c. der Betrag der Erhöhung in Franken festgelegt wird.

decisions.must_determine: For an index-linked lease: whether the notification was given only AFTER the new index level had been publicly announced, and, for an increase based on the consumer price index, whether it was announced with at least 30 days' notice to the end of a month.
quotes: Bei indexgebundenen Mietverhältnissen darf die Mitteilung frühestens nach der öffentlichen Bekanntgabe des neuen Indexstandes erfolgen.
Mietzinserhöhungen gestützt auf den Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise können unter Einhaltung einer Frist von mindestens 30 Tagen auf ein Monatsende angekündigt werden.

Die Vereinbarung, dass der Mietzins einem Index folgt, ist nur gültig, wenn der Mietvertrag für mindestens fünf Jahre abgeschlossen und als Index der Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise vorgesehen wird.

decisions.must_determine: Whether to demand from the landlord that the claimed differential be substantiated in figures, and to register that making that demand does NOT extend, suspend or otherwise touch the 30-day challenge period. The interaction rule is part of the decision: a reconstruction that records the demand but not its non-tolling effect has not made this decision. The right exists only where the increase rests on cost increases or value-adding improvements.
quotes: Bei Mietzinserhöhungen wegen Kostensteigerungen oder wegen wertvermehrenden Verbesserungen des Vermieters kann der Mieter verlangen, dass der geltend gemachte Differenzbetrag zahlenmässig begründet wird. Die 30-tägige Anfechtungsfrist wird dadurch nicht berührt.
durch Kostensteigerungen oder Mehrleistungen des Vermieters begründet sind;

decisions.must_determine: Whether the increased rent is abusive within the meaning of OR 269, and whether each ground the landlord ACTUALLY STATED on the form brings it within one of the OR 269a safe harbours as those grounds are concretised by VMWG Art. 11-16. The determination is per stated ground and cumulative: it must establish which grounds were asserted, and whether the amount attributed to each stays within the corresponding statutory limit, measured from the rent last validly fixed. A reconstruction that assesses the total increase without decomposing it by stated ground has not made this decision.
quotes: Mietzinse sind missbräuchlich, wenn damit ein übersetzter Ertrag aus der Mietsache erzielt wird oder wenn sie auf einem offensichtlich übersetzten Kaufpreis beruhen.

Mietzinse sind in der Regel nicht missbräuchlich, wenn sie insbesondere: a. im Rahmen der orts- oder quartierüblichen Mietzinse liegen; b. durch Kostensteigerungen oder Mehrleistungen des Vermieters begründet sind;

Als Kostensteigerungen im Sinne von Artikel 269a Buchstabe b OR gelten insbesondere Erhöhungen des Hypothekarzinssatzes, der Gebühren, Objektsteuern, Baurechtszinse, Versicherungsprämien sowie Erhöhungen der Unterhaltskosten.
Das Eidgenössische Departement für Wirtschaft, Bildung und Forschung (WBF)

Zum Ausgleich der Teuerung auf dem risikotragenden Kapital im Sinne von Artikel 269a Buchstabe e OR darf der Mietzins um höchstens 40 Prozent der Steigerung des Landesindexes der Konsumentenpreise erhöht werden.
Mietzinserhöhungen werden grundsätzlich von der letzten verbindlichen Mietzinsfestsetzung (gerichtlicher Vergleich, rechtskräftige Mietzinserhöhung oder Anfangsmietzins) her berechnet.

decisions.must_determine: For an index-linked lease: whether the adjustment demanded is justified by a corresponding movement of the index, and nothing else. Before the conciliation authority no other objection to the amount is admissible, the challenge of the initial rent excepted. This is a strictly narrower determination than D12 and it takes a different evidence set.
quotes: Unter Vorbehalt der Anfechtung des Anfangsmietzinses kann eine Partei vor der Schlichtungsbehörde nur geltend machen, dass die von der andern Partei verlangte Erhöhung oder Herabsetzung des Mietzinses durch keine entsprechende Änderung des Indexes gerechtfertigt sei.
Haben die Parteien für die Miete einer Wohnung einen indexierten Mietzins vereinbart, darf die jeweilige Mietzinserhöhung die Zunahme des Landesindexes der Konsumentenpreise nicht übersteigen.
Bei indexgebundenen Mietverhältnissen darf die Mitteilung frühestens nach der öffentlichen Bekanntgabe des neuen Indexstandes erfolgen.

decisions.must_determine: Whether to lodge a conciliation request, with which authority, and in what form. The authority is the one for the place where the immovable lies; conciliation precedes any decision procedure; the request may be filed in the forms of ZPO 130 or dictated to the record at the authority, must name the opposing party, the prayer for relief and the subject-matter, and must be filed in one paper copy for the authority and one for each opposing party.
quotes: Dem Entscheidverfahren geht ein Schlichtungsversuch vor einer Schlichtungsbehörde voraus.
Das Verfahren wird durch das Schlichtungsgesuch eingeleitet. Dieses kann in den Formen nach Artikel 130 eingereicht oder mündlich bei der Schlichtungsbehörde zu Protokoll gegeben werden.
Im Schlichtungsgesuch sind die Gegenpartei, das Rechtsbegehren und der Streitgegenstand zu bezeichnen.
Für Klagen aus Miete und Pacht unbeweglicher Sachen ist das Gericht am Ort der gelegenen Sache zuständig.

Eingaben und Beilagen in Papierform sind in je einem Exemplar für das Gericht und für jede Gegenpartei einzureichen; andernfalls kann das Gericht eine Nachfrist ansetzen oder die notwendigen Kopien auf Kosten der Partei erstellen.
in dem sich das Mietobjekt befindet (zuständiges Bezirksgericht)
Vous pouvez également utiliser une simple lettre, signée, contenant la désignation de la partie
in doppelter Ausführung einreichen (Art. 131 ZPO)

decisions.must_determine: Whether a conciliation attempt must be held here or falls away: it precedes the decision procedure as a rule, is excluded in the enumerated cases, may be waived jointly where the amount in dispute reaches CHF 100 000, and may be waived unilaterally by the claimant in the listed situations. The answer selects which annex the later court filing must carry — the Klagebewilligung or the declaration of waiver — and is therefore what makes ZPO 244 Abs. 3 lit. b a genuine alternative rather than a single fixed document.
quotes: Dem Entscheidverfahren geht ein Schlichtungsversuch vor einer Schlichtungsbehörde voraus.
Das Schlichtungsverfahren entfällt: a. im summarischen Verfahren;
Bei vermögensrechtlichen Streitigkeiten mit einem Streitwert von mindestens 100 000 Franken können die Parteien gemeinsam auf die Durchführung des Schlichtungsverfahrens verzichten.
Die klagende Partei kann einseitig auf das Schlichtungsverfahren verzichten, wenn: a. die beklagte Partei Sitz oder Wohnsitz im Ausland hat; b. der Aufenthaltsort der beklagten Partei unbekannt ist;

Kommt es zu keiner Einigung, so hält die Schlichtungsbehörde dies im Protokoll fest und erteilt die Klagebewilligung: a. bei der Anfechtung von Miet- und Pachtzinserhöhungen: dem Vermieter oder Verpächter; b. in den übrigen Fällen: der klagenden Partei.

facts.statement: That the let object consists of residential or commercial premises, or of things the landlord lets together with such premises.
The number and kind of habitable rooms, excluding the kitchen, and whether the object is a luxury dwelling or a single-family house — the facts that decide the OR 253b Abs. 2 exclusion.
Whether the provision of the dwelling was publicly promoted and whether its rent is subject to authority control, for the period in issue.
The content of the landlord's communication: whether it raises the rent, reduces the landlord's existing services, or introduces new ancillary costs.

The rent regime agreed in the lease and its validity conditions: ordinary rent; index-linked (contract for at least five years, consumer price index as the index); or staggered (contract for at least three years, at most one increase per year, the amount fixed in francs).
The calendar date on which the notification entered the tenant's sphere of control — the day from whose morrow the 30-day challenge period runs.
The mode of dispatch and, where the notification was sent by registered mail, the delivery or collection record for that specific consignment.
The provenance of the instrument used to notify: whether it is the canton's own official form, or the landlord's own form carrying that canton's approval endorsement and its date, or neither.
The place and canton in which the let premises lie, which fixes whose approval the form must carry, which conciliation authority is competent, and which court hears any action.
The previous net rent and the previous ancillary-cost burden as stated on the instrument served.
The new net rent and the new ancillary-cost burden as stated on the instrument served.
The date on which the increase is stated to take effect.
The reason or reasons stated for the increase, and the individual franc amount attributed to each where more than one is invoked.

Whether the instrument states that the landlord receives subsidies for value-adding improvements. Required only where an improvement ground is invoked; when none is, this item and the subsidy evidence fall away.
Whether the instrument sets out the statutory conditions of challenge and the register of conciliation authorities with their local jurisdiction.

Whether the reasons are given in an accompanying letter and, if so, whether the form expressly refers to that letter, together with the letter's content. Required only on the covering-letter branch; when the reasons are on the form itself, this fact and the letter that evidences it fall away.
Whether the landlord reserves an unexercised part of the adjustment and whether that reservation is expressed in francs or as a percentage of the rent.

Whether the notification, or any document served with it, threatens or pronounces a termination of the lease — hence the whole of what was transmitted, including any page the instrument itself declares to be part of it.
Which, if any, of the three nullity limbs of OR 269d Abs. 2 is satisfied on the facts established for D4, D5 and D6 — a determination, not a matter of separate evidence.

The notice period and termination dates applicable to this lease — those agreed if longer or different, otherwise the statutory default for dwellings or for business premises — and the type of premises that selects the default.
The next possible termination date following the notification, and the date on which the notice period running to it begins — computed from F6 and F20, not separately evidenced.
The date on which each step of the staggered rent takes effect and the date of the written notification of that step. Required only on the staggered branch.

The date on which the new index level was publicly announced, the date of the notification relying on it, and for a consumer-price-index increase the month end on which it is to take effect. Required only on the index-linked branch.

Whether and when the tenant demanded a numerical substantiation of the claimed differential, what the landlord supplied in answer, and that the demand left the 30-day challenge period untouched. Required only where a cost-increase or improvement ground is invoked.

The rent and ancillary-cost charge last validly fixed for these premises — by court settlement, by an increase that has become final, or by the initial rent — and every adjustment made since, in date order and without gaps.

For each ground invoked, the underlying movement or expenditure relied on — the movement of the mortgage reference interest rate announced quarterly by the WBF, the increase in charges, object taxes, ground rents, insurance premiums or maintenance costs, or the movement of the consumer price index — and the arithmetic connecting it to the franc amount claimed for that ground. Required only on the cost-increase or improvement branch.

For a comparator-based ground: the location, size, fittings, condition and construction period of each premises offered as a comparator and of the let premises, the rent actually paid for each comparator in the relevant period, plus the official statistics to be taken into account. Required only where the local-comparator ground is invoked; if it is not, the comparator documentation is removable outright.

For a Mehrleistung ground: that the works were executed and the supporting documents existed before the increase was announced, the share of the cost that exceeds restoration or maintenance of the original condition, and the amount of any subsidies received for the value-adding improvements.
For an index-linked lease: the publicly announced index level at the reference date and at the date of notification, and whether the increase demanded is covered by the movement between them.

The designation of every party as it appears in the lease, and whether the property management is the owner or merely the representative, together with the prayer for relief and the subject-matter of the dispute.
The conciliation authority for the place where the premises lie, and the date on which the request reached it or was handed to the Swiss Post.

The form in which the request is made — signed paper, electronic with a qualified signature, or dictated to the record at the authority — and the number of copies filed, one for the authority and one for each opposing party.

The amount in dispute, and whether any statutory exception to or waiver of conciliation applies — summary procedure, joint waiver at CHF 100 000 or more, the respondent's seat or domicile abroad, an unknown whereabouts, or a single cantonal instance.
Whether a rent reduction is claimed in the same filing as the challenge of the increase.

The date of the written reduction request made to the landlord and the content or absence of his response within 30 days. Required only where the reduction is pursued separately; when it is claimed simultaneously with the challenge, OR 270a Abs. 3 removes this fact and the documents that evidence it.
Every ground of the increase for which the tenant demands production of the relevant supporting records in the conciliation procedure, and what the landlord produced or failed to produce for each.

Whether each party appeared in person, or an exemption applies — out-of-canton or foreign domicile, illness, age or another important reason — or, on the landlord's side, the property management was delegated.
Whether the delegated property management holds written authority to conclude a settlement on the landlord's behalf. Required only where the landlord delegates instead of appearing.
Any earlier conciliation or court proceedings between the same parties concerning this tenancy, identified by authority or court, year and case number.

Which outcome the conciliation produced: a signed record of settlement, acknowledgement of claim or unqualified withdrawal; a proposed decision; a decision by the authority; a failure recorded in the minutes; or the default of the claimant, of the respondent, or of both.
Whether the claimant applied for the authority to decide the matter itself, the amount in dispute not exceeding CHF 2000.

That the subject-matter of the proceedings is the challenge of a rent increase — the fact that makes the LANDLORD, not the challenging tenant, the addressee of the Klagebewilligung and the party against whom the filing period runs.

Where the route ran through a proposed decision: which party rejected it and on what date, measured from its written opening — the fact that displaces the rent-increase allocation rule in favour of the rejecting-party rule.
Whether a proposed decision was opened, on what date it was opened in writing, and whether a party rejected it within 20 days.
The date on which the Klagebewilligung was opened, from which the 30-day filing period runs, together with the particulars the authorisation must contain.

Whether the party bearing the burden filed the action with the court within the period and on what date, and, where a proposed decision had been rejected, the consequence that the proposal is deemed acknowledged if it did not.
Whether a party acts through a representative and the scope of that representative's authority. Required only where there is representation.
Whether a conciliation procedure was held, so that an authorisation to proceed exists, or was validly waived, so that a declaration of waiver takes its place.
The party designations, the prayer for relief, the subject-matter, where needed the amount in dispute, and the date and signature of the simplified action.
Which available documents the filing party intends to serve as evidence, listed so that the court can see what is produced.

That a conciliation or court procedure over the increase is pending and that no agreement was reached in conciliation — the condition on which the existing lease continues unchanged and the old rent remains the rent payable.

That the matter arises from the lease of residential or commercial premises — the fact that triggers the exclusion of court costs — and whether an authorisation to proceed was granted, which is what would otherwise impose the conciliation costs on the claimant.

The content and date of a termination, the date it was received, and whether it was declared in order to push through the rent adjustment or during a pending connected conciliation or court procedure.

capabilities.must_show: What the let object physically is and that it is let as residential or commercial premises, as between these parties.

How many habitable rooms the object has, excluding the kitchen, and whether it is a house or a flat, so that the luxury and six-room thresholds can be tested against the same object the lease describes.
Whether the provision of the dwelling was publicly promoted and whether an authority controls its rent, for the period in issue.
The complete, unaltered content of everything the landlord transmitted as the notification, page for page, including any page the instrument itself declares to be part of it.

The rent clause as agreed between these parties — whether the rent follows an index, rises periodically by a fixed franc amount, or neither — together with the contract term and the increase cadence that make such a clause valid.
The calendar date on which the notification entered the tenant's sphere of control, fixed independently of the tenant's own assertion where it is contested.
How the notification was dispatched and, for registered dispatch, the tracking history for that specific consignment, including any failed delivery attempt and the date of collection.

That the instrument used carries the competent canton's approval — either because that canton issued it or because it bears that canton's approval endorsement with its date — or that no such approval exists.
Where the let premises are located, to an address, with sufficient precision to fix the competent canton and district.
The instrument's entries as served, read for the previous rent and the previous ancillary-cost burden, so that each can be found present or absent on its face.
The same entries as served, read for the new rent and the new ancillary-cost burden.
The date the increase is stated to take effect, as it appears on the instrument served.
Each ground asserted and the separate franc amount attributed to it, at a level that tells an itemised justification from an undifferentiated one.
Whether the instrument served discloses receipt of subsidies for value-adding improvements, and if so in what amount.
Whether the instrument served reproduces the statutory conditions of challenge and the register of conciliation authorities with their local jurisdiction.
That the instrument served itself directs the reader to a separate accompanying letter as the place where the reasons are given, and what that letter says by way of reasons.
Any reservation of an unexercised part of the adjustment, and whether it is quantified in francs or as a percentage of the rent rather than left unquantified.

The whole of what was transmitted with the notification, such that the presence or absence of a threat or declaration of termination is demonstrable from the transmission itself and not from recollection.

The terms binding these parties that fix the notice period and the termination dates, including any agreed period longer than the statutory one, and the type of premises that selects the statutory default.

The index clause binding these parties, the publicly announced index level relied on, and the date of that public announcement measured against the date of the notification.
That a demand for a numerical substantiation was made to the landlord and on what date, and what the landlord supplied in answer.

The rent and ancillary-cost charge last fixed in a binding way between these parties, on what instrument they were so fixed, and the complete sequence of changes from that point to the contested increase, so that no intermediate change is missing.

The actual movement or expenditure behind each asserted ground, at a level of detail that lets the amount claimed for that ground be checked against it rather than accepted as a flat rate — primary records, not a summary prepared for the proceedings.

For each comparator offered, that it matches the let premises on location, size, fittings, condition and construction period — all five for the same object, not a subset — and the rent actually paid for it, together with what the official statistics record for comparable premises.

That the works were completed and documented before the increase was announced, which part of the expenditure exceeds restoration or maintenance of the original condition, and the amount of any subsidy received for it.
The officially published index levels at the reference date and at the notification date, and the arithmetic linking them to the adjustment demanded.

Who the contracting parties are as named between them, in what capacity each is bound — owner as against property management — and what the tenant asks for and on what facts, identifying the contested instrument and its date.
That a request was lodged with the conciliation authority for the place where the premises lie, and the date on which it reached that authority or was handed to the Swiss Post.
That the request was made in an admissible form — signed on paper, electronically with a qualified signature, or dictated to the record — and in the required number of copies.

The monetary value of what is in dispute, derivable from the difference between the old and the new rent over the relevant period, and any circumstance grounding an exception to or waiver of conciliation, in particular the opposing party's seat or domicile abroad or an unknown whereabouts.
That a reduction request is, or is not, made in the same filing as the challenge.
That a written reduction request reached the landlord, on what date, and what he answered within 30 days or that he did not answer.
For each ground relied on, what the landlord produced in the conciliation procedure when production was demanded and what he failed to produce.
Who attended the hearing for each side, and the circumstance exempting anyone who did not attend in person.
That the delegated property management is empowered, in writing, to conclude a settlement on the landlord's behalf.
Any earlier conciliation or court proceedings between the same parties, identified by authority or court, year and case number.

What the conciliation produced and on what date, in a form that distinguishes a signed settlement record from a proposed decision, from an authority decision, and from a failure recorded in the minutes.
That the claimant applied for the authority to decide the matter itself, and that the amount in dispute is within the statutory ceiling for that application.

Whether the action was filed with the court within the period, and on what date.

Either that an authorisation to proceed was granted, or that the conciliation procedure was validly waived.
The party designations, the prayer for relief, the subject-matter, where needed the amount in dispute, and the date and signature of the action.
Which documents the filing party actually has available and intends to rely on as evidence, presented so that the court can see what is produced.
That the challenge is pending before the conciliation authority or the court, with the date of pendency, and that no agreement was reached in conciliation.
That the matter arises from the lease of residential or commercial premises, and whether an authorisation to proceed was granted.

deadlines.runs_from: The communication of the increase to the tenant. Three cantonal renderings read 'mitgeteilt worden ist' as RECEIPT ('nach Empfang der Mitteilung', 'seit Empfang', 'des la reception de l'avis'). The period begins on the day following the communication (ZPO 142 Abs. 1); it is a statutory period and cannot be extended (ZPO 144 Abs. 1); the court vacations do NOT suspend it, because it concerns the conciliation procedure (ZPO 145 Abs. 2 lit. a); it is observed by filing with the authority or handing the submission to the Swiss Post on the last day at the latest (ZPO 143 Abs. 1); and a demand for a numerical substantiation does not touch it (VMWG 20 Abs. 1). Missing it makes the increase effective.

terminals: T1 NULLITY. The increase is null under OR 269d Abs. 2 — not notified on the prescribed form, not reasoned, or accompanied by a threat or declaration of termination. It produces no effect at all and requires no challenge by the tenant ('Die Mietzinserhoehung ist nichtig (ohne Anfechtung unwirksam)'); the rent last validly fixed continues to be owed. Reachable WITHOUT any substantive assessment of abusiveness, and therefore without the whole merits evidence set.

T2 OUTSIDE THE PROTECTION. The object is a luxury dwelling or a single-family house with six or more habitable rooms, or is publicly promoted housing whose rent is authority-controlled: the abusive-rent provisions do not apply and the scope ends before any form question (OR 253b Abs. 2, Abs. 3).
T3 INCREASE VALID AND UNCHALLENGED. The 30-day period of OR 270b Abs. 1 passes without a request reaching the conciliation authority — 'Verpasst sie die Frist, so wird die Erhoehung wirksam.'

T4 INCREASE VALID BUT DEFERRED. Notified less than ten days before the start of the notice period, so it takes effect only at the next-but-one termination date — 'Sonst wirkt die Erhoehung erst auf den uebernaechsten Kuendigungstermin'. A timing defect, not a nullity.
T5 STAGGERED RENT, NO CHALLENGE ON THE MERITS. Subject to the challenge of the initial rent, the tenant cannot challenge staggered rents; the matter ends without a substantive assessment (OR 270d).

T6 AGREEMENT AT CONCILIATION. A settlement, acknowledgement of claim or unqualified withdrawal taken to the record and signed by the parties, one copy each, with the effect of a final judgment (ZPO 208 Abs. 1 and Abs. 2).
T7 PROPOSED DECISION ACCEPTED BY SILENCE. No party rejects it within 20 days of its written opening: deemed accepted, with the effect of a final judgment (ZPO 211 Abs. 1).
T8 PROPOSED DECISION REJECTED, ACTION NOT FILED IN TIME. The proposal is deemed acknowledged and has the effect of a final judgment (ZPO 211 Abs. 3).
T9 DECISION BY THE CONCILIATION AUTHORITY. A pecuniary dispute not exceeding CHF 2000, decided by the authority itself in oral proceedings on the claimant's application (ZPO 212 Abs. 1).
T10 CLAIMANT'S DEFAULT. The request counts as withdrawn and the proceedings are written off as moot (ZPO 206 Abs. 1).
T11 DEFAULT OF BOTH PARTIES. The proceedings are written off as moot (ZPO 206 Abs. 3).

T12 KLAGEBEWILLIGUNG TO THE LANDLORD. No agreement; the authority records the failure in the minutes and issues the authorisation, in a challenge to a rent increase, to the LANDLORD, with a 30-day Klagefrist running against him (ZPO 209 Abs. 1 lit. a, Abs. 4). This is a valid end state of the conciliation stage as seen from the tenant: the tenant receives NO authorisation and has no filing period to observe. (The respondent's default leads here too, ZPO 206 Abs. 2.)

T13 KLAGEBEWILLIGUNG TO THE REJECTING PARTY. After the rejection of a proposed decision in a matter under ZPO 210 Abs. 1 lit. b, the authorisation goes to the rejecting party — a different allocation rule from T12 (ZPO 211 Abs. 2 lit. a).

T14 JUDGMENT IN THE SIMPLIFIED PROCEDURE. A decision of the court at the place where the immovable lies, in the simplified procedure that applies irrespective of the amount in dispute because protection against abusive rents is concerned, the court having established the facts of its own motion (ZPO 33, 243 Abs. 2 lit. c, 247 Abs. 2 lit. a).
T15 MEDIATION. On the application of all the parties, mediation takes the place of the conciliation procedure; if a party notifies its failure, the Klagebewilligung is issued (ZPO 213 Abs. 3).

T16 LEASE CONTINUES UNCHANGED (an interim, not a final, state). Throughout the conciliation procedure where no agreement is reached, and throughout the court proceedings subject to the court's interim measures, the existing lease continues unchanged (OR 270e) — which excludes any assertion that the increased rent is owed while the challenge is pending.
